description: This file contains utility functions related to Model-View-Controller (MVC) pattern in a SuiteCRM application, including view loading, print link generation, AJAX module restrictions, and URL linking for AJAX interactions.

methods.name: loadParentView
methods.description: Loads the parent view PHP file based on the specified type, checking in custom and core include paths.

methods.name: getPrintLink
methods.description: Generates a JavaScript link for printing, differing if the request was via AJAX or not.

methods.name: ajaxBannedModules
methods.description: Returns an array of module names that are restricted from AJAX operations, including configurable overrides.

methods.name: ajaxLink
methods.description: Modifies a URL to be compatible with AJAX UI, considering module restrictions and whether AJAX is disabled in configuration.
